Name: Custom Dog Skin - Sam the Aussie Cattle Mix
Author: deadduch
Description:
Edit: This mod is old, and I never intend to update it to the new content. If anyone wants to take this and update it for themselves/others, permission granted.

Meet Sam, a dog skin based off of a dog that someone had requested. Add him to your game today.

Find the thread of my to do list and ask for requests on this thread: [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-pet-skins-beroins-mod.109346/]http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-pet-skins-beroins-mod.109346/

[/url]Mod Compatibilities

Using the Cursors.xnb in this mod will overwrite any other mod that has made changes to that image.
